title: Platen
tagline: A typewriter with a bell, no backspace and a two-colour ribbon.
how_to: Tap the keys (sound on); listen for the margin bell, press Return, and try Demo.
description: A tactile typewriter you play on your phone. Each strike lands slightly off, ink varies, and the carriage jams at the margin so letters pile up. Nudge the carriage and roll the platen by half lines to overstrike, then watch Demo type a moon in two passes.
spark: Taken literally: the whole thing is a typewriter, down to the bell and the missing backspace.
proud_of: Everything is synthesized live, from the key clack and the Return ratchet to the bell's inharmonic ring.
